resources.string: Drag either side edge to move the window. Swipe in the middle to change the camera or adjust framing. Pinch with two fingers to resize.\n\nThe corner controls expand or close the window. If Button mode is enabled in Settings, use its camera controls instead of horizontal swipes.

Swipe right in the middle: Rear → Left → Front → Right → Rear. Swipe left to go the other way.\n\nThe Front and Rear only option skips the side views. The rear picture is mirrored, like a rear-view mirror.

A wide, shallow window shows a strip of the picture without stretching it. Drag down in the middle to see more of the top; drag up to see more of the bottom.\n\nA nearly square window already shows most of the picture, so there may be little room to move it.

Drag a side edge until more than half the window is off screen, then release. A small strip remains; tap it or pull it back to restore the window.\n\nA window that stays fully on screen does not hide automatically, even when it is close to the edge.

Spread two fingers to enlarge the window; pinch to make it smaller. Its shape stays the same. Move both fingers together to reposition it while resizing.\n\nTo change the shape, adjust width and height separately in Settings. A flatter window crops the picture instead of stretching it.

Follow the system installer prompts. When installation finishes, tap Back at the top left instead of Open in the middle.

On affected head units, tapping Open can leave the installer stuck and interfere with the next update. Return to the launcher and open Zeekr Companion there.

Downloading starts only after you confirm below. Press Back now to cancel.
